title: Best robot lawn mower deal: Save $311 on Segway Navimow i110N
excerpt: Yard maintenance doesn't need to be difficult.
content_html:
SAVE $311: As of Sept. 1, the Segway Navimow i110 is on sale for $788 at Amazon. That's a 28% discount on the list price.

Credit: Navimow

$789 at Amazon
$929 Save $140

Mowing the lawn is one of those chores that is so easy to put off. And if you really hate to do it, how does the idea of taking mowing completely off your to-do list sound? With a robot lawn mower, it is entirely possible.

Right now at Amazon, there's a great deal on the Segway Navimow i110, so you can upgrade for less. As of Sept. 1, it's priced at just $788. It normally costs $1,099, so that's a savings of $311.

This robot lawn mower doesn't require any perimeter wires. Instead, with a smartphone-guided setup, you can map virtual lawn boundaries in just a few taps, helping it navigate seamlessly. Plus, AI-assisted mapping can identify lawn edges and automatically map the working area. It also has a 140-degree field-of-view camera that can identify more than 150 common garden objects (such as toys and plant pots) and avoid them.

Once you have it all set up, the Navimow mower follows its planned mowing patterns to ensure full coverage. It even changes direction after reaching 100% coverage to minimize tracks. And if it runs out of battery on the job, it recharges itself before continuing until the job is done.
